title: Conjunctions (So, such, such as, as, because) - Cause, result, and examples

options.answer: He was so tired that he couldn't walk.
He was so tired as he couldn't walk.
He was tired such he couldn't walk.

explanation.en: The correct structure for showing a result after an adjective is 'so + adjective + that + clause.' The other options use 'as' or 'such' incorrectly.
explanation.ru: Правильная конструкция для выражения результата после прилагательного - 'so + прилагательное + that + предложение'. В других вариантах 'as' или 'such' используются неправильно.
explanation.uz: Sifatdan keyin natijani ko'rsatish uchun to'g'ri tuzilma 'so + sifat + that + jumla'dir. Boshqa variantlarda 'as' yoki 'such' noto'g'ri ishlatilgan.

options.answer: She speaks English fluently, so she can travel easily.
She speaks English fluently, because she can travel easily.
She speaks English fluently, as she can travel easily.

explanation.en: The word 'because' is used to show a cause. Here, the cause of her ability to travel easily is that she speaks English fluently.
explanation.ru: Слово 'because' используется для выражения причины. Здесь причиной ее способности легко путешествовать является то, что она свободно говорит по-английски.
explanation.uz: 'Because' so'zi sababni ko'rsatish uchun ishlatiladi. Bu yerda uning oson sayohat qilish qobiliyatining sababi ingliz tilida erkin gapirishi.

options.answer: It was such a hot day that we went swimming.
It was so a hot day that we went swimming.
It was such hot day that we went swimming.

explanation.en: The correct structure for showing a result with a noun phrase is 'such + (a/an) + adjective + noun + that + clause.' The other options use the wrong structure.
explanation.ru: Правильная конструкция для выражения результата с существительным - 'such + (a/an) + прилагательное + существительное + that + предложение'. В других вариантах используется неправильная структура.
explanation.uz: Otli birikma bilan natijani ko'rsatish uchun to'g'ri tuzilma 'such + (a/an) + sifat + ot + that + jumla'dir. Boshqa variantlar noto'g'ri tuzilishdan foydalanadi.

options.answer: As I was walking, I saw a friend.
I saw a friend as I was walking.
I saw a friend, as I was walking.

explanation.en: The conjunction 'as' is used to talk about two actions happening at the same time. It can connect two clauses and is often used to introduce a subordinate clause.
explanation.ru: Союз 'as' используется для описания двух действий, происходящих одновременно. Он может соединять два предложения и часто используется для введения придаточного предложения.
explanation.uz: 'As' bog'lovchisi bir vaqtda sodir bo'layotgan ikkita harakat haqida gapirish uchun ishlatiladi. U ikkita jumlani bog'lashi mumkin va ko'pincha qo'shma jumlani kiritish uchun ishlatiladi.

question.en: Choose the sentence that shows a result.

options.answer: It was cold, because it was winter.
It was winter, so it was cold.
It was cold as it was winter.

explanation.en: The conjunction 'so' is used to show a result. Here, being cold is a result of it being winter. 'Because' shows the cause.
explanation.ru: Союз 'so' используется для выражения результата. Здесь 'холодно' является результатом 'зимы'. 'Because' показывает причину.
explanation.uz: 'So' bog'lovchisi natijani ko'rsatish uchun ishlatiladi. Bu yerda 'sovuq' bo'lish qish bo'lishining natijasidir. 'Because' sababni ko'rsatadi.

options.answer: I was very tired, so I went to bed early.
I was so tired, so I went to bed early.
I was so tired as I went to bed early.

explanation.en: The word 'so' is used to connect a cause and its result. The first part of the sentence is the cause (tiredness), and the second is the result (going to bed early).
explanation.ru: Слово 'so' используется для связи причины и ее результата. Первая часть предложения - это причина (усталость), а вторая - результат (ранний отход ко сну).
explanation.uz: 'So' so'zi sabab va uning natijasini bog'lash uchun ishlatiladi. Gapning birinchi qismi sabab (charchoq), ikkinchisi esa natija (ertaroq uxlashga borish) hisoblanadi.

options.answer: He is so friendly a person that everyone likes him.
He is so friendly that everyone likes him.
He is such friendly that everyone likes him.

explanation.en: The correct structure is 'so + adjective + that + clause' when there is no noun after the adjective. 'Such' is used with a noun phrase.
explanation.ru: Правильная конструкция - 'so + прилагательное + that + предложение', когда после прилагательного нет существительного. 'Such' используется с существительным.
explanation.uz: Sifatdan keyin ot bo'lmaganda to'g'ri tuzilma 'so + sifat + that + jumla'dir. 'Such' ot bilan ishlatiladi.

options.answer: I like fruits, such as apples, oranges, and bananas.
I like such fruits as apples, oranges, and bananas.
I like such apples, oranges, and bananas.

explanation.en: The phrase 'such as' is used to introduce examples of something mentioned previously. The structure 'such as + list of examples' is the correct one.
explanation.ru: Фраза 'such as' используется для введения примеров чего-то, упомянутого ранее. Правильная структура - 'such as + список примеров'.
explanation.uz: 'Such as' iborasi oldin tilga olingan narsalarga misollar keltirish uchun ishlatiladi. 'Such as + misollar ro'yxati' tuzilmasi to'g'ri hisoblanadi.

options.answer: I was very cold, because I didn't wear a jacket.
I was very cold, so I didn't wear a jacket.
I was very cold, as I didn't wear a jacket.

explanation.en: The word 'because' is used to show a cause. Not wearing a jacket is the cause for being cold.
explanation.ru: Слово 'because' используется для выражения причины. Отсутствие куртки - причина холода.
explanation.uz: 'Because' so'zi sababni ko'rsatish uchun ishlatiladi. Ko'ylak kiymaslik sovuq qotishning sababidir.

options.answer: It was so a big car that it didn't fit.
It was such a big car that it didn't fit.
It was such big car that it didn't fit.

explanation.en: 'Such a big car' is a correct noun phrase that shows a result. 'So' is used with adjectives, not nouns.
explanation.ru: 'Such a big car' - это правильное существительное, которое показывает результат. 'So' используется с прилагательными, а не существительными.
explanation.uz: 'Such a big car' natijani ko'rsatadigan to'g'ri otli birikma. 'So' otlar bilan emas, sifatlar bilan ishlatiladi.

prompt.en: Complete the sentence with a cause: I bought a new dress, ___ I had a party to attend.
prompt.ru: Дополните предложение причиной: I bought a new dress, ___ I had a party to attend.
prompt.uz: Gapni sabab bilan to'ldiring: I bought a new dress, ___ I had a party to attend.

options.answer: because

explanation.en: The conjunction 'because' is used to introduce the reason or cause for the action of buying a new dress.
explanation.ru: Союз 'because' используется для введения причины или основания для действия - покупки нового платья.
explanation.uz: 'Because' bog'lovchisi yangi ko'ylak sotib olish harakatining sababini yoki asosini kiritish uchun ishlatiladi.

prompt.en: Complete the sentence with a result: It rained all day, ___ the streets were wet.
prompt.ru: Дополните предложение результатом: It rained all day, ___ the streets were wet.
prompt.uz: Gapni natija bilan to'ldiring: It rained all day, ___ the streets were wet.

options.answer: so

explanation.en: The conjunction 'so' is used to show a result. The wet streets are a result of the rain.
explanation.ru: Союз 'so' используется для выражения результата. Мокрые улицы - это результат дождя.
explanation.uz: 'So' bog'lovchisi natijani ko'rsatish uchun ishlatiladi. Ko'chalar yomg'ir tufayli ho'l bo'lgan.

prompt.en: Complete the sentence: The sun was ___ bright that I couldn't open my eyes.
prompt.ru: Дополните предложение: The sun was ___ bright that I couldn't open my eyes.
prompt.uz: Gapni to'ldiring: The sun was ___ bright that I couldn't open my eyes.

options.answer: so

explanation.en: 'So' is used before an adjective without a noun to show a result. 'Such' would be incorrect here.
explanation.ru: 'So' используется перед прилагательным без существительного для выражения результата. 'Such' здесь будет неправильным.
explanation.uz: 'So' sifatdan oldin, ot bo'lmaganda natijani ko'rsatish uchun ishlatiladi. Bu yerda 'such' noto'g'ri bo'ladi.

prompt.en: Complete the sentence: It was ___ a big surprise that she cried.
prompt.ru: Дополните предложение: It was ___ a big surprise that she cried.
prompt.uz: Gapni to'ldiring: It was ___ a big surprise that she cried.

options.answer: such

explanation.en: 'Such' is used before a noun phrase like 'a big surprise' to show a result. 'So' would be incorrect here.
explanation.ru: 'Such' используется перед существительным, таким как 'a big surprise', для выражения результата. 'So' здесь будет неправильным.
explanation.uz: 'Such' 'a big surprise' kabi otli birikmadan oldin natijani ko'rsatish uchun ishlatiladi. Bu yerda 'so' noto'g'ri bo'ladi.

prompt.en: Complete the sentence: I like many hobbies, ___ cooking and reading.
prompt.ru: Дополните предложение: I like many hobbies, ___ cooking and reading.
prompt.uz: Gapni to'ldiring: I like many hobbies, ___ cooking and reading.

options.answer: such as

explanation.en: The phrase 'such as' is used to introduce examples of the hobbies you like.
explanation.ru: Фраза 'such as' используется для введения примеров хобби, которые вам нравятся.
explanation.uz: 'Such as' iborasi sizga yoqadigan hobbi misollarini kiritish uchun ishlatiladi.

prompt.en: Complete the sentence: ___ he was walking, he found a wallet.
prompt.ru: Дополните предложение: ___ he was walking, he found a wallet.
prompt.uz: Gapni to'ldiring: ___ he was walking, he found a wallet.

options.answer: As

explanation.en: 'As' is used here to show that the action of finding a wallet happened while he was walking.
explanation.ru: 'As' здесь используется для того, чтобы показать, что действие 'найти кошелек' произошло, пока он шел.
explanation.uz: 'As' bu yerda uning yurib borayotganida hamyon topganligini ko'rsatish uchun ishlatiladi.

prompt.en: Complete the sentence: He was not feeling well, ___ he went to the doctor.
prompt.ru: Дополните предложение: He was not feeling well, ___ he went to the doctor.
prompt.uz: Gapni to'ldiring: He was not feeling well, ___ he went to the doctor.

options.answer: so

explanation.en: 'So' is used to show a result or consequence. Going to the doctor is a result of not feeling well.
explanation.ru: 'So' используется для выражения результата или следствия. Поход к врачу - это результат того, что он неважно себя чувствовал.
explanation.uz: 'So' natija yoki oqibatni ko'rsatish uchun ishlatiladi. Shifokorga borish o'zini yaxshi his qilmaslikning natijasidir.

prompt.en: Complete the sentence: She was happy ___ she passed the exam.
prompt.ru: Дополните предложение: She was happy ___ she passed the exam.
prompt.uz: Gapni to'ldiring: She was happy ___ she passed the exam.

options.answer: because/as

explanation.en: 'Because' or 'as' are used to state the reason for her happiness. Passing the exam is the cause of her happiness.
explanation.ru: 'Because' или 'as' используются для обозначения причины ее счастья. Сдача экзамена - причина ее счастья.
explanation.uz: 'Because' yoki 'as' uning baxtining sababini bildirish uchun ishlatiladi. Imtihondan o'tish uning baxtining sababidir.

prompt.en: Complete the sentence: He had ___ little money that he couldn't buy food.
prompt.ru: Дополните предложение: He had ___ little money that he couldn't buy food.
prompt.uz: Gapni to'ldiring: He had ___ little money that he couldn't buy food.

options.answer: so

explanation.en: 'So' is used with 'little' or 'few' before a noun to express a result. The result is not having enough money to buy food.
explanation.ru: 'So' используется с 'little' или 'few' перед существительным для выражения результата. Результат - отсутствие достаточного количества денег, чтобы купить еду.
explanation.uz: 'So' ot oldidan 'little' yoki 'few' bilan natijani ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi. Natija esa oziq-ovqat sotib olishga yetarli pul yo'qligi.

prompt.en: Complete the sentence: They went to see a movie, ___ they had finished their homework.
prompt.ru: Дополните предложение: They went to see a movie, ___ they had finished their homework.
prompt.uz: Gapni to'ldiring: They went to see a movie, ___ they had finished their homework.

options.answer: as/because

explanation.en: 'As' or 'because' are used here to provide the reason why they went to see a movie. The reason is that they had finished their homework.
explanation.ru: 'As' или 'because' используются здесь, чтобы указать причину, по которой они пошли смотреть фильм. Причина в том, что они закончили домашнее задание.
explanation.uz: 'As' yoki 'because' bu yerda ularning nima uchun film ko'rgani sababini ko'rsatish uchun ishlatiladi. Sabab - ular uy vazifasini tugatganlari.
